content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Fayetteville

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your PMP Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a secondary degree plus documented project-management experience, or a high school diploma with additional experience. Review PMI's education and hours requirements, then gather your project documentation. Granite PM Academy's advisors can help verify you meet the credential's prerequisites before enrollment.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course. Attend sessions from Fayetteville on your schedule; no travel required. Our active certified practitioners cover all five process groups and knowledge areas. Upon completion, you'll receive the formal contact hours PMI requires for application eligibility.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing your 35-hour course, register with PMI and complete the PMP application, detailing your project-management experience. Pay the applicable PMI examination fee. PMI will review and verify your credentials, typically within days. Once approved, you'll receive your authorization to test.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Granite PM Academy provides exam-preparation resources, practice questions, and study guidance aligned to the PMBOK Guide. Schedule your exam at a testing center or via remote proctoring. Our instructors remain available to clarify concepts. Pass the 180-question, four-hour PMP examination to earn your credential.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: The PMP credential requires renewal every three years. Earn professional development units (PDUs) through continuing education, project work, or volunteer activities. Granite PM Academy offers PMP-eligible courses to help you meet renewal requirements and stay current with evolving project-management practices.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.
